description: Source code for a stub video decoder implementation in the starboard media framework, including methods for initialization, buffer processing, and frame creation.

classes.name: StubVideoDecoder
classes.description: A mock implementation of a video decoder that simulates decoding behavior for testing or placeholder purposes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of frames to preroll, fixed at 1.

methods.name: GetPrerollTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout for prerolling, using a large constant.

methods.name: GetMaxNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of frames that can be cached, fixed at 12.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Accepts input buffers and schedules decoding jobs.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of the input stream and processes remaining frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and cancels pending jobs.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target, which is invalid in this stub.

methods.name: DecodeBuffers
methods.description: Processes input buffers, manages frame buffering, and calls status callbacks.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Outputs remaining frames and signals end of stream.

methods.name: CreateOutputFrame
methods.description: Creates a dummy video frame with specified timestamp.
